lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: George is playing with his ball in the garden.
lines.zh: 乔治在花园里玩他的球。

lines.en: Peppa wants to play, too.
George, you're doing it all wrong!
This is how to catch a ball.
Not like this.
That's what you do.
What a cheeky little one Peppa is.
lines.zh: 佩奇真是个淘气的小家伙。

lines.en: George! Come back, you little piggy.
lines.zh: 乔治！回来，你这个小猪崽。

lines.en: Maybe Peppa is teasing George just a bit too much.
lines.zh: 也许佩奇捉弄乔治有点过头了。

lines.en: Peppa, have you been teasing George?
lines.zh: 佩奇，你是不是在捉弄乔治？

lines.en: Not really, Mummy. I was teaching him how to catch.
lines.zh: 其实没有，妈妈。我是在教他怎么接球。

lines.en: Really? Well, I know a game that will teach George how to catch. It's called Piggy In The Middle.
lines.zh: 真的吗？嗯，我知道有个游戏能教会乔治接球。它叫「中间的小猪」。

lines.en: Peppa, you take the ball and stand over there. And, George, you stand over there.
lines.zh: 佩奇，你拿着球站到那边去。乔治，你站到那边。

lines.en: Good. You have to throw the ball to each other and I have to try and catch it. I'm the piggy in the middle.
lines.zh: 很好。你们要把球互相传给对方，而我要试着把球抢到。我就是中间的那只小猪。

lines.en: Mummy is the piggy in the middle!
lines.zh: 妈妈是中间的那只小猪！

lines.en: Catch, George. Oh. Missed it.
George has caught the ball.
Hurray!
Well done, George. Now you throw the ball to Peppa.
lines.zh: 做得好，乔治。现在你把球扔给佩奇。

lines.en: Ooh. Try again.
Oh... Try again.
George cannot throw the ball past Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 乔治没法把球扔过猪妈妈。

lines.en: Come on, George, give the ball to me.
Silly George!
I can do that, too.
Peppa wanted to copy George, but she's too big and has got stuck.
lines.zh: 佩奇想学乔治的样子，可是她太大了，卡住了。

lines.en: I've got the ball. Peppa, now it's your turn to be piggy.
lines.zh: 我拿到球了。佩奇，现在轮到你当中间的小猪了。

lines.en: George, catch.
Hurray!
Caught it! George, you're the piggy!
lines.zh: 接住了！乔治，你是中间的小猪！

lines.en: George, catch.
Catch the ball, George.
Catch, George.
George, catch!
Here's the ball, George.
Whee!
Oh, dear. Peppa, you shouldn't tease George like that.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。佩奇，你不该那样捉弄乔治。

lines.en: Sorry, George.
What's all the noise?
